sourceTitle: A Biblical and Theological Dictionary explanatory of the history, manners, and customs of the Jews, and neighbouring nations
description: "A Biblical and Theological Dictionary" by Richard Watson is a reference work written in the early 19th century. This dictionary aims to provide an explanatory resource on the history, manners, and customs of the Jews, as well as pertinent insights on remarkable places and individuals mentioned in the Bible.
